blocks.html:
Motorcycle / Bike Wrap

You might not be thinking about getting out on the open road in the middle of winter. However, Spring is on its way. The warmer weather is coming and so is the chance to open the throttle on your Kawasaki bike.

Fancy changing up your motorbike this year, giving it a refresh? That is exactly what one customer of Vinyl Wrap Toronto did last year. The Kawasaki Ninja is a beautiful bike in white, the customer decided that he needed a change, hence full bike wrap. He chose to wrap the whole bike in carbon fiber vinyl. This bike wrap called for many of the outer bodywork to be removed and wrapped individually.

Our installation crew not only have to know how to install vinyl, but they must also be mechanics at times. The transformation from white to carbon fiber is quite a change. The vinyl also acts as a protective layer for the bike. So, when the owner either sells his Kawasaki bike or decides to revert to the original colour. The white paint will be almost exactly like the day it was wrapped. To remove the vinyl is easy for our crew. Click here to know more.

Visit us at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke to speak to one of our experienced installers about your motorcycle wrap.
